edits.before: A traditional parsnip grown for long roots and good flavour. Keep as the familiar open-pollinated alternative.
edits.after: A traditional parsnip with long roots and good flavour. Best grown in deep, stone-free soil.

edits.before: Rake clean; test acid soil before liming to pH 6.5.

additionalVarieties.name: White Gem
additionalVarieties.text: Sweet, stocky roots for shallower or heavier soil, with some canker resistance.
